docText: Super admin - all EPP functions across all providers
graphText: Super admin - all EPP functions across all providers. A blanket super-permission, not tied to any single operation; epp-api.yml's per-operation x-permissions-required lists never name it directly (e.g. createEppProvider is gated by epp.provider.create), so no sd:PermissionRequirement is modeled for it here — it is presumed to satisfy every other permission's check at the authorization-layer level, which is outside what an individual PermissionRequirement can express.
